summary: tools/env.sh honours L5R_GODOT (one shared Godot for all worktrees, no .tools junction) and gains l5r_require_godot, called by the 54 tools scripts that run $GODOT unguarded, so a missing Godot prints an explicit error and exits 1 instead of dying silently under set -e. Sourcing env.sh stays non-fatal so check.sh --skip-client is unaffected. CONTRIBUTING documents it.
validation: Bad L5R_GODOT: check-crimson-duel.sh prints the error, exit 1. No .tools plus valid L5R_GODOT: check-crimson-duel.sh all 9 views PASS. check.sh --skip-client: All requested checks passed. bash -n clean on all tools scripts. Windows Git Bash only; macOS not run locally (CI macOS job covers it).
